findings.title: getListingById import resolves to undefined at runtime
findings.issue: edit.astro line 11 imports { getListingById, getAllListingCategories } from '@/lib/db/queries/listings'. The listings.ts module only exports getAllListingCategories. getListingById was removed from listings.ts to fix the prior TS2308 barrel duplicate. Astro/Vite defaults to shimMissingExports: true, which silently resolves missing named imports to undefined. The page renders, but when a user visits /admin/listings/[id]/edit, await getListingById(id) calls undefined with an argument, causing TypeError: 'undefined is not a function'.
findings.evidence: listings.ts exports: getAllListingCategories only (26 lines, grep getListingById = 0). edit.astro:11 imports getListingById from listings. edit.astro:16: const listing = await getListingById(id ?? ''); -- will throw TypeError.
findings.suggestion: Fix import path in edit.astro:11 to import from '@/lib/db/queries' (the barrel re-exports getListingById from admin-listings.ts), OR restore getListingById in listings.ts as: export { getListingById } from './admin-listings'.
findings.impact: The entire admin listing edit page crashes on load for every user. Cannot edit any listing.

findings.title: T-002 spec not fulfilled -- listings.ts missing 3 of 4 required functions
findings.issue: T-002 requires listings.ts to export getAdminListings, getListingById, createListing, updateListing. The file (26 lines) only contains getAllListingCategories. These functions exist in admin-listings.ts but NOT in listings.ts as the plan explicitly instructed. This violates the architectural decision in plan.md line 45: 'extend existing query files rather than creating new ones.'
findings.evidence: tasks.md T-002: 'Export getAdminListings, getListingById, createListing, updateListing' in listings.ts. Actual: listings.ts has only getAllListingCategories.
findings.suggestion: Move getAdminListings, createListing, and updateListing into listings.ts per the spec, OR update plan.md and tasks.md to document the actual split.
findings.impact: Spec non-compliance. Future developers following T-002 will look for these functions in listings.ts and not find them.

findings.title: admin/listings.ts server actions have 3 type errors
findings.issue: tsc --noEmit confirms 3 TS2379 errors in actions/admin/listings.ts related to exactOptionalPropertyTypes. ListingFilters (line 45), CreateListingInput (line 61), and UpdateListingInput (line 93) all have optional properties being passed with explicit undefined values.
findings.evidence: tsc --noEmit: actions/admin/listings.ts:45 TS2379, line 61 TS2379, line 93 TS2379.
findings.suggestion: Add 'undefined' to the type definitions for these input interfaces.
